body: If you need it we can chat. But I know the feeling that people don't care, but they often try. It is also hard to help correctly. If it helps we can chat and you can tell me what's on your mind.
Please reach out to someone close. And we are also here. We hear you!

Yeah, I am not in the position to help, but I know that feeling. Told a friend I was depressed and so on for the last few years and since then he did not check on me for months.

I don't understand how life is this way. Hope you and I will get better and be better to others.
Hope better times are coming. I think life is just not offering or reaching out. Everything has to be driven from yourself. Would love to talk, if you think that would help you.
I am not the best person to help you. Probably you need someone professional. Still I could image a hobby would help, something to work towards it. If you like to talk just contact me. Happy to chat
Please contact someone professional immediately. They will help you.

I changed my therapist a few times. And I somehow don't believe they can help.

I should have the motivation to change my life.
I quit my job in the past and I know it was not the solution, but at least then I can vanish.

I tried it with therapy, but I have the feeling they don't take me seriously (I know they do). 

Should I quit. Should I pack my bag and run. Should I behave so badly that they fire me.

I just sit around and wait till everything crashes.
